text: Based on the tool output, the 2025 loss of 13.5 hectares in asset ASSET-F was observed as tree-cover loss. The event area was predominantly mapped as forest in 2020 (98% according to JRC GFC2020). The forest type over the event area was primarily native forest (13.1 hectares), with a small portion outside mapped forest (0.4 hectares) and no planted forest. The loss does not appear to be due to land clearing for agriculture, as the area was consistently mapped as forest and there is no indication of conversion to agricultural use. The latest observed year is 2025, and no later year observations are available for this event.
